programme.title: The Case of Marcel Duchamp
programme.desc: 1984. Drama. Director: David Rowan. Stars Guy Rolfe, Raymond Francis & Juliet Hammond. Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson exit retirement to solve a case concerning the artist, Marcel Duchamp.

programme.title: A Good Read with Mike Read
programme.desc: The Ides of March - Part 1. Mike Read reads classic Raffles stories from The Amateur Cracksman by E.W. Hornung and begins with the exciting tale The Ides of March.

programme.title: Twilight's Last Gleaming
programme.desc: 1977. Thriller. Directed by Robert Aldrich. Stars Burt Lancaster, Richard Widmark & Roscoe Lee Browne. An imprisoned rogue Air Force general seizes a nuclear silo and threatens to start WWIII.

programme.title: Hero of the Hour
programme.desc: 2000. Crime. Directed by David Richards. Stars Ross Kemp, Maggie O'Neill & Julie Armstrong. A security guard becomes a national hero after fending off armed robbers. So why does he feel on edge?

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: The Suffragette. 1956. Stars Hugh O'Brian, Linda Stirling & Howard Wendell. When a women's suffrage movement hits town Wyatt becomes caught up in the dangerous conflict that arises.

programme.title: The Westerner
programme.desc: Hand on the Gun. 1962. Director: Sam Peckinpah. Stars: Brian Keith, Spike & Hank Gobble. An inexperienced Easterner, wants to learn the ways of the West. Dave agrees to teach Cal wrangling.

programme.title: Algiers
programme.desc: 1938. Drama. Directed by John Cromwell. Stars Charles Boyer, Hedy Lamarr & Sigrid Gurie. A wanted jewel thief hiding in the Casbah meets a beautiful woman who makes him long for an escape.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: The fabulous actress and singer Debbie Reynolds performs the wonderful song We'll Sing in the Sunshine.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Brick Making/Stonehenge. 1986. After a visit to a brick maker in Dorset, Jack Hargreaves takes us to Salisbury Plain to witness sunrise at Stonehenge on a mid-winter's day.

programme.title: Our Girl Friday
programme.desc: 1953. Comedy. Director Noel Langley. Stars Joan Collins, George Cole, Kenneth More & Hattie Jacques. A British cast lead this story about a shipwrecked group on a tropical island.

programme.title: Flockton Flyer
programme.desc: Race You For It. 1978. Stars Peter Duncan, Geoffrey Russell, David Neal. The 17th Duke of Flockton has died, and his son reclaims the 4 miles of track previously on loan from his father (S2, E01)

programme.title: Rumpole of the Bailey
programme.desc: Rumpole and the Quacks. Stars: Leo McKern, Marion Mathie, Patricia Hodge. Rumpole defends a Pakistani doctor accused of misconduct.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Quarry. 1977. Stars Marc Boyle & Mike Elles. It takes over four minutes to get out of the quarry. The police sealed it off in under two. How have four raiders and a boxful of dynamite vanished?

programme.title: Behind the Mask
programme.desc: 1958. Drama. Director: Brian Desmond Hurst. Stars: Michael Redgrave, Tony Britton & Carl Möhner. A newly qualified surgeon takes the blame for a drug addict colleague after the death of a patient.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Sign of Four
programme.desc: 1987. Thriller. Director: Peter Hammond. Stars Jeremy Brett, Edward Hardwicke, Jenny Seagrove. A young lady contacts Sherlock Holmes for his help regarding her father who disappeared 10 years ago.

programme.title: The Silent Invasion
programme.desc: 1962. War. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Eric Flynn, Petra Davies, Francis De Wolff. When the Nazi's take over a small village during WWII, a local girl inadvertently falls in love with an officer.

programme.title: Aspinall's Animals
programme.desc: And Life Goes On... There are very few Black Rhinos left in the world, 15 of them are in Aspinall's park. There is a new arrival, a female rhino from Rome Zoo is due to arrive.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: The Bomb
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Directed by Blake Edwards. Stars David Niven, Margaret Sheridan & John Dehner. Three people become trapped in an abandoned farmhouse and discover a live bomb in the basement.

programme.title: Time To Remember
programme.desc: Edwardian Summer. 1959. Narrated by Sir Ralph Richardson. A look back at a period of technological and political change from 1905 to 1910 during the reign of Edward VII.

programme.title: The Mind of Mr. J. G. Reeder
programme.desc: 1971. Find the Lady. Stars Hugh Burden, Willoughby Goddard, Gillian Lewis. As she is about to be announced at the palace, a young debutante is spirited away.

programme.title: Autumn Leaves
programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Directed by Robert Aldrich. Stars Joan Crawford, Cliff Robertson & Vera Miles. A woman's romance with a younger man becomes a nightmare when his past comes back to haunt them both.

programme.title: The Cater Street Hangman
programme.desc: 1998. Crime. Directed by Sarah Hellings. Stars Eoin McCarthy, Keeley Hawes & Peter Egan. A Scotland Yard inspector teams up with a feisty aristocratic woman to hunt down a serial killer in London.

programme.title: A Good Read with Mike Read
programme.desc: The Ides of March - Part 2. Mike Read continues with the second part of the fascinating tale The Ides of March in which Bunny becomes involved in a life of crime as Raffles' junior partner.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is back with more spooky features to enjoy! Tonight, Caroline presents the first episode of the chilling 1984 anthology series Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense.

programme.title: Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense
programme.desc: Mark of the Devil. 1984. Stars Dirk Benedict & Jenny Seagrove. A desperate gambler robs a tattoo artist, but he is pricked by an inking needle and marked with a cursed tattoo.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: After a thrilling night of horror, Caroline Munro gives a quick glimpse of next week's episode.

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: 1940. Comedy. Director: Howard Bretherton. Stars Frankie Darro, Marjorie Reynolds & Mantan Moreland. An unpopular radio singer is killed on air. It's up to the radio page boy to solve the mystery.

programme.title: A Lifetime Ago with The Baim Collection
programme.desc: Enchanted Cities. 1957. Narrated by Kenneth Macleod. A tour of the beautiful Italian cities of Florence and Venice.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Garden Party. 1963. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Harriet E. MacGibbon & Sharon Tate. Mrs. Drysdale is having a garden party and accidently 'invites' the Clampetts to attend.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Swindler. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Nearest and Dearest
programme.desc: 1972. Comedy. Directed by John Robins. Stars Hylda Baker, Jimmy Jewel & Edward Malin. After their father's death, two siblings inherit a decrepit pickle factory and attempt to keep it afloat.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout December.

programme.title: Blind Spot
programme.desc: 1958. Crime Drama directed by Peter Maxwell. Starring Robert Mackenzie, Michael Caine and Delphi Lawrence. US Officer Adams, blinded during the war, is framed on a diamond-smuggling rap.

programme.title: Flockton Flyer
programme.desc: Ready When You Are, Mr Cutley. 1978. Stars Anthony Sharp, Geoffrey Russell, John Moulder-Brown. A film crew arrives to make a historical re-enactment of the Indian Mutiny (S2, E02)

programme.title: Rumpole of the Bailey
programme.desc: Rumpole for the Prosecution. Stars: Leo McKern, Marion Mathie, Peter Blythe. Rumpole agrees to prosecute for the first time.
